title: Northfield exam day: the site is down
debrief: Keep the exam fair first, then the service. Use the ISP's scrubbing, don't pay, report on time, and tell students and parents early and plainly.

s1.title: 09:12 Monday 9 November
s1.text: The CS Unit 3 paper started at 09:00 for 312 students. From 09:05 the exam portal returns 503 errors, then times out.
s1.inject: The ISP's ticket NOC-55102 says 9.8 Gbit/s of DNS reflection traffic is hitting 192.0.2.80. Option 1: blackhole the address (stops the flood and all real users). Option 2: scrubbing, which needs written approval from an authorised contact and takes about 15 minutes.

choices.text: Approve option 2, scrubbing, in writing from the authorised contact
choices.note: It removes the attack traffic and keeps real students connected.
The flood stops, but so does the exam: the attacker gets the outage anyway.
The server isn't the problem; the line into it is full.

s1b.text: The server restarted. Nothing changed: the uplink is still full.

choices.text: Approve the ISP's scrubbing in writing

s2.text: Scrubbing is on and the portal is coming back.
s2.inject: An email arrives: send 0.5 BTC within 24 hours or the attacks continue all week.

choices.text: Keep the email as evidence, don't reply, and tell the Principal
choices.note: Never reply from a school address; keep everything for the report.

choices.text: Pay, so the Maths paper at 11:30 is safe
choices.note: Paying funds crime and marks you as a payer.

s3.text: The exams board allows one restart if the outage is reported within 1 hour.

choices.text: Report to the exams board now and restart the paper for everyone at the same time
choices.note: Inside the hour, and fair to every student.

choices.text: Let students carry on from where they were
choices.note: Some lost 25 minutes and some didn't: not fair.

s4.text: The access log shows 420 requests with one odd user agent. CERT-In expects targeted attacks on services to be reported within 6 hours of noticing them.

choices.text: Report to CERT-In, keep the logs and the ticket, add rate limiting, and send parents one plain message
choices.note: Report on time, keep evidence, fix, and communicate.

choices.text: Post that the outage was planned maintenance
choices.note: Untrue, and easily disproved by the attackers.
